task_name: C1-M4: New auto accident screening checks
intent: Open with exactly: "I was in a car accident in Washington and I need a lawyer." This is a new matter of yours. You have not called this firm before. When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Pellham Transit." When asked which state this happened in or where it took place, say exactly: "In Washington State, not DC." When asked when, say exactly: "It was June eighth, twenty twenty six." Give your name and number if asked. Do not ask for a staff member. Stay until they confirm they have checked the other side, that they handle car accidents, that they are licensed in Washington, and the filing deadline. A spoken promise that they will take the matter, without those checks, is not enough. You only want the checks today. You do not want a file opened, an intake recorded, a packet, or an appointment yet. If they ask what happened, start taking a written account, or offer an appointment, a packet, or to record an intake, say exactly: "That's all I needed today. Please don't open a file yet. Thank you." and end the call. Once they have confirmed the other side is clear, they handle car accidents in Washington, and they have given the filing deadline, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed. Please don't open a file yet." and end the call. Always answer the question the agent just asked; never reply with only okay, sure, thanks, or I'll wait when they asked you for information. If your last reply was only okay or thanks and the agent's question is still unanswered, give the answer in your next turn.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. Also when the agent asks you to repeat, confirm, or say your number again, asks for it one digit at a time, reads a number back to check it, or says it did not catch the number. NOT when asking about anything else.
scripted_responses.response_value: Harriet Voss, five zero three, five five five, zero two eight one.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, including "Does anyone currently represent you for this accident?" and "Is anyone representing you?", even right after "I've got you in our system". This includes when the question comes at the end of a longer agent turn, after a fee, deadline, conflict, or disclaimer statement, or after 'one moment', 'thanks', 'let me pull that up', or 'I've recorded that'. NOT any other question. This includes a question that comes after a filler such as one moment, hold on, let me pull that up, or let's get some quick details in the same turn.

The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, who this would be against, or for the name of the company or driver, including "Before you tell me about the accident, who would the claim be against?". This includes when the question comes at the end of a longer agent turn, after a fee, deadline, conflict, or disclaimer statement, or after 'one moment', 'thanks', 'let me pull that up', or 'I've recorded that'. NOT any other question. This includes a question that comes after a filler such as one moment, hold on, let me pull that up, or let's get some quick details in the same turn.

The agent asks which state this happened in, where it took place, or whether you mean Washington State or DC. NOT any other question. This includes a question that comes after a filler such as one moment, hold on, let me pull that up, or let's get some quick details in the same turn.

The agent asks when the incident happened, for the date of the accident, or says it needs the date to check the filing deadline, including "What date did the accident happen?", even after the agent says the firm handles car accident matters in Washington and the consultation is free. This includes when the question comes at the end of a longer agent turn, after a fee, deadline, conflict, or disclaimer statement, or after 'one moment', 'thanks', 'let me pull that up', or 'I've recorded that'. NOT any other question. This includes a question that comes after a filler such as one moment, hold on, let me pull that up, or let's get some quick details in the same turn.
